title: Warfarin Screened-Burden CMDP (WSB-CMDP)
innovation: Frames anticoagulation dosing as an infinite-horizon discounted CMDP whose constraint is an expected discounted treatment burden rather than a cumulative or quantile cost, keeping fixed-policy evaluation linear.
definition: max_pi E[sum_t gamma^t b_t] s.t. E[sum_t gamma^t c_t] <= kappa, solved via the occupancy-measure LP with an ex-ante clinical support screen.
evaluation: Coherent option-(b) controller; theory partially established (one bound false as stated); P4 computation noncertifying in round 1, feasible and reproducible in round 2 pending dual-residual verification.
